It's made from the finest hard wood of trees that grow only in Korok Forest, so it's sturdier than it looks.|Inventory|TotK}} Forest Dweller's Shields go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 30 |durability = 18 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Forest Dweller's Shield}} Forest Dweller's Shields are [[Shield]]s made by [[Korok]]s specifically for [[Hylian]]s to use. This is common among [[Korok Gear]], which includes all [[Weapon]]s created by Koroks.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 172}} They are only found in three locations in and around the [[Great Hyrule Forest]], though an additional one can be found in a [[Treasure Chest]] at [[Floria Falls]]. They are made from the finest hard wood in the [[Korok Forest]], making them deceivingly sturdy. As part of "[[The Test of Wood]]" [[Shrine Quest]], [[Damia]] will give [[Link]] a Forest Dweller's Shield, [[Forest Dweller's Sword]], and [[Forest Dweller's Bow]] he must use to fight his way to the [[Maag Halan Shrine]].{{Cite|But it's not complicated—all you need to do is equip the {{Color BotW|Red|Korok weapon set}} and reach the shrine at the back of the area.|Damia|BotW}} If he switches out or breaks any of these [[Item]]s, the trial must be restarted.{{Cite|You have to keep the {{Color BotW|Red|sword}}, {{Color BotW|Red|bow}}, and {{Color BotW|Red|shield}} equipped the whole time. If they break or you unequip them, you're out!|Damia|BotW}} Being made of wood, Forest Dweller's Shields will burn to a crisp if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. If Link drops them in [[Water]], they will float. They also do not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] in [[Thunderstorm]]s like a metal shield would. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_023" |Life = 18 |GuardPower = 30 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 4 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 6 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 9 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 12 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 30 |durability = 18 |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Forest Dweller's Shield}} {{Stub|TotK}} Forest Dweller's Shields reappear in {{TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Forest Dweller's Shields can be wielded by Link in conjunction with [[Forest Dweller's Sword]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Korok Gear * Shield }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Korok Gear, Shields |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
